  Goldman Sees AI Reshaping Indian Work
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/26f1e95d?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* Goldman Sachs estimates generative AI could replace 8–12% of
India’s non-agricultural jobs while complementing 42–48% by automating
routine tasks and boosting productivity. Services such as education, media,
finance, and professional work face the most exposure, while construction
and other physical occupations remain relatively insulated, pointing to
broad labor reallocation rather than mass unemployment over time. *Read

  Microsoft Softens Its AI Bill
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/03df996e?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* To soften the reported cost of its AI buildout, Microsoft is
extending the estimated life of data centers and offices from 15 to 25
years, shifting more leases outside reported capex. The accounting change
does not reduce actual investment: 2026 spending remains about $175
billion, while fiscal 2027 capex is still expected to rise further. *Read
more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/447456bb?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

  AI Traffic Favors Buying Pages
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/c7b59fb7?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* WebFX analyzed nearly 600,000 AI referral sessions across 2,500
URLs and found that AI sends users mostly to decision-stage content, not
awareness pages. Homepages led with 31.3%, while product, service, blog,
and FAQ pages captured most remaining traffic. Pages with specific facts,
pricing, citations, and expert signals performed best, suggesting AI
rewards content that helps buyers act. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/52d667a0?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  AI Cracks Outsourcing’s Revenue Engine
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/681ed978?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* Indian IT outsourcing giant Infosys cut its fiscal 2027 growth
forecast to 1.5–3.0%, acknowledging that customers are shifting technology
work toward AI. The warning matters beyond one company: outsourcing was
built on expanding teams and billable effort, but AI lets clients
internalize more capability, compress project scope, and spend less on
labor-heavy services, weakening the industry’s traditional revenue
engine. *Read
more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/fe0a580e?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Agents Scale Sleep Discovery
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/4e6a2715?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Researchers built AI Sleep Co-Scientist, an expert-guided system
that analyzed roughly 124,000 sleep studies and more than 50 TB of
physiological signals. By automating labor-intensive preprocessing,
hypothesis development, and statistical analysis while keeping humans in
review. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/c64ceb3f?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Amazon Tests Health Agents
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/4bf08f96?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Amazon introduced PatientAgentBench, a clinician-vetted framework
that creates synthetic patient records and multiturn conversations to test
healthcare AI agents on safety, triage, workflows, and task completion.
Across thousands of evaluations, even frontier models missed crisis
resources, fabricated clinical details, and mishandled routine requests
hiding serious risks. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/37c9d7df?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Zuckerberg Bets on Personal Agents
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/5da1aabb?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg predicts billions of people will use
personal AI agents within five years to manage finances, health,
relationships, and households through platforms like WhatsApp. He says
these agents will underpin Meta’s next products and revenue, even as AI
infrastructure spending surges, free cash flow falls 91%, and Reality Labs’
cumulative losses reach roughly $88 billion. *Read more →*
